d: The Collection Specialist is responsible for managing and monitoring customer receivables and collection activities across the Company's real estate portfolio. The role ensures timely collection of customer payments in accordance with sale and purchase agreements, payment schedules and approved credit terms, while maintaining accurate receivable records, following up on overdue balances, supporting collection plans, and coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to minimize outstanding receivables and improve cash collections.
q: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience in collections, accounts receivable, credit control, or customer relationship management, preferably within the real estate, property development, banking, or financial services sector.
Experience in managing customer receivables, payment schedules, overdue accounts, and collection activities.
Experience with ERP and/or CRM systems, preferably in a real estate or property development environment.
Good understanding of customer contracts, payment terms, receivables aging, reconciliation, and collection procedures.
Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to deal professionally with customers and internal stakeholders.
Good knowledge of MS Excel and financial reporting tools.
r: Monitor customer accounts receivable and follow up on installments, down payments, and other amounts due in accordance with approved payment schedules and Sale and Purchase Agreements (SPAs).
Proactively communicate with customers through calls, emails, payment reminders, and other approved channels to ensure timely payment and follow up on overdue amounts.
Maintain and update customer payment schedules, collection records, outstanding balances, and payment status in the ERP/CRM system.
Prepare and maintain customer aging reports, collection status reports, and overdue balances for regular review by the Finance Manager.
Coordinate with the Finance team to verify customer payments, reconcile receipts, and ensure accurate allocation of collections to the respective customer accounts.
Coordinate with Sales, Customer Service, CRM, and other relevant departments to resolve customer payment discrepancies and collection-related queries.
Monitor approved customer payment arrangements and escalate overdue, disputed, or high-risk accounts to the Finance Manager for further action.
Provide supporting documentation and customer payment records to the Finance Manager and Legal Department for accounts requiring formal recovery action.
Maintain proper documentation of customer collection records, payment confirmations, correspondence, and supporting documents in accordance with company procedures.
Perform other related duties as assigned by the Finance Manager and adhere to applicable company policies and procedures.

The Head of Marketing is responsible for driving brand growth and business performance through integrated marketing strategies that maximize revenue, lead generation, and ROI. This role ensures alignment with commercial goals by using data-driven insights and focusing on measurable outcomes such as market share and lead-to-revenue conversion. It leads the marketing team in executing impactful campaigns that boost brand visibility and customer engagement. The role develops and implements marketing plans aligned with the business strategy, supporting the sales function. It also ensures campaigns adhere to Al Rostamani Group’s policies and overall business objectives. Additionally, the role enhances the image, awareness, and consideration of ARTC, its brands, and services through consistent, impactful communication across all channels.
q: Minimum Bachelor's degree. Marketing Specialization is preferred
3-5 years marketing experience in reputed organization in a leadership position
Related Industry experience is a must
Knowledge of media production, communication, and dissemination techniques and methods. This includes alternative ways to inform via written, oral, visual and social media
Strong understanding of marketing principles, lead generation strategies, and sales support.
Strong understanding of digital marketing tools and ecosystem. Data-driven decision-making approach and strong analytical skills.

Knowledge of administrative and clerical procedures and systems such as word processing, usage of reporting tools like excel, power BI, managing files and records, designing forms, and other office procedures and terminology

r: Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape within the automotive and commercial vehicle sectors.
Oversee day-to-day marketing operations and coordinate with various other marketing functions (including shared services) and marketing vendors to drive campaign execution.
Ensure adherence to Group Marketing Policies and Procedures for all activities.
Manage marketing services administration through collaboration with cross-functional support teams like finance, legal and IT.
Manage the marketing budget, ensuring all spending is within approved parameters, justified and efficient.

Plan and prepare advertising and promotional material to increase sales of products or services, working with customers, group marketing, company officials, sales departments, and advertising agencies.
Develop and implement lead generation campaigns, including email marketing, digital advertising, and content marketing.
Collaborate with product management and sales teams to understand product features, benefits, and competitive advantages to effectively communicate to target audiences.
Utilize marketing automation tools and CRM systems to optimize campaign performance, track ROI, and nurture leads through the sales funnel.
Coordinate participation in industry trade shows, exhibitions, and conferences to enhance brand visibility and generate qualified leads.
Develop booth strategies, promotional materials, and presentations to effectively showcase products and engage with prospects and customers.
Provide sales team with marketing support, including lead generation activities, customer insights, and competitive positioning strategies.
Collect and analyze data on customer demographics, preferences, needs, and buying habits to identify potential markets and factors affecting product demand.
Set clear objectives and measurement metrics for all marketing campaigns that align with the business and group objectives.
Develop tools and dashboards to monitor marketing performance, media purchases, and the efficiency of campaigns and activities, providing actionable insights for continuous improvement.
Manage digital platforms, data management, and data mining initiatives to drive targeted marketing strategies and support business objectives.
Lead cross-actions and synergies with other entities within the Al Rostamani Group to maximize collaboration, efficiency, and brand impact.
Manage media planning and buying activities, ensuring effective allocation of budgets and maximizing return on investment.

d: Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
q: Education: Bachelor's degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field.

Payment Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of payment business models, transaction flows, merchant payment scenarios, payment channels, and core business metrics; deep knowledge of the payment industry ecosystem and business growth logic.

Technical Skills: Proficient in SQL (Hive/ODPS) and Python; capable of independently handling complex data analysis, data processing, and analytical model development; familiar with Tableau, Power BI, DeepInsight, or other BI tools.

Experience in BI, Product Analytics, or Business Analytics at established payment platforms or PSPs.

Experience building business metric frameworks and analytical structures from scratch (0 to 1), or supporting new payment product launches and business growth initiatives.
Demonstrated track record of driving product optimization, payment conversion rate improvement, transaction volume growth, merchant growth, or revenue growth through data analysis.

Independently own complex end-to-end analytical projects, including problem definition, analytical framework design, hands-on data analysis, strategic recommendations, execution driving, and impact evaluation.
